018package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.util;
019
020import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
021import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
022import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
023
024import java.util.ArrayList;
025import java.util.Collection;
026import java.util.Collections;
027import java.util.HashSet;
028import java.util.List;
029import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.HBaseTestingUtil;
030import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.ServerName;
031import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.Admin;
032import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.net.Address;
033import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.rsgroup.RSGroupInfo;
034import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.rsgroup.RSGroupUtil;
035import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.MediumTests;
036import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.MiscTests;
037import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.util.RegionMover.RegionMoverBuilder;
038import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterAll;
039import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeAll;
040import org.junit.jupiter.api.Tag;
041import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
042
043/**
044 * Unit tests for {@link RegionMover#filterRSGroupServers}. RSGroups is enabled on the mini cluster
045 * and servers are moved between groups via the real {@code moveServersToRSGroup} admin call -- no
046 * test constructs an {@link RSGroupInfo} by hand. Every {@code RSGroupInfo} used here is read back
047 * from the master via {@code admin.getRSGroup(...)}, which computes "default" membership as "online
048 * servers minus servers claimed by other groups" (see RSGroupInfoManagerImpl#getDefaultServers), so
049 * its membership shrinks on its own once a move happens instead of being asserted into existence by
050 * the test.
051 */
052@Tag(MiscTests.TAG)
053@Tag(MediumTests.TAG)
054public class TestRegionMoverFilterRSGroupServers {
055
056  private static final HBaseTestingUtil TEST_UTIL = new HBaseTestingUtil();
057
058  @BeforeAll
059  public static void setUpBeforeClass() throws Exception {
060    RSGroupUtil.enableRSGroup(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration());
061    TEST_UTIL.startMiniCluster(2);
062  }
063
064  @AfterAll
065  public static void tearDownAfterClass() throws Exception {
066    TEST_UTIL.shutdownMiniCluster();
067  }
068
069  private RegionMover buildMover() throws Exception {
070    ServerName any = TEST_UTIL.getAdmin().getRegionServers().iterator().next();
071    return new RegionMoverBuilder(any.getHostname() + ":" + any.getPort(),
072      TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration()).build();
073  }
074
075  private static Address addressOf(ServerName sn) {
076    return Address.fromParts(sn.getHostname(), sn.getPort());
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Reproduces HBASE-30331: once a server is moved out of "default" into a custom group, the
081   * master-computed "default" RSGroupInfo only lists the server that remains. filterRSGroupServers
082   * must honor that real membership instead of short-circuiting on the group name and returning
083   * every online server.
084   */
085  @Test
086  public void testDefaultGroupFiltersToActualMembers() throws Exception {
087    Admin admin = TEST_UTIL.getAdmin();
088    List<ServerName> allServers = new ArrayList<>(admin.getRegionServers());
089    assertEquals(2, allServers.size(), "Mini cluster should have started with 2 region servers");
090
091    ServerName movedOut = allServers.get(0);
092    ServerName inDefault = allServers.get(1);
093    String groupName = "test_default_filter";
094
095    admin.addRSGroup(groupName);
096    admin.moveServersToRSGroup(new HashSet<>(List.of(addressOf(movedOut))), groupName);
097    try {
098      // Master-computed membership, not something we constructed ourselves.
099      RSGroupInfo defaultGroup = admin.getRSGroup(RSGroupInfo.DEFAULT_GROUP);
100      assertEquals(1, defaultGroup.getServers().size(),
101        "Master-computed default group should shrink to 1 member after moving the other "
102          + "server out");
103      assertTrue(defaultGroup.containsServer(addressOf(inDefault)),
104        "Server that was not moved out must remain in the default group's real membership");
105
106      try (RegionMover rm = buildMover()) {
107        Collection<ServerName> result = rm.filterRSGroupServers(defaultGroup, allServers);
108
109        assertEquals(1, result.size(),
110          "filterRSGroupServers should return only the default group's actual members");
111        assertTrue(result.contains(inDefault),
112          "Server that is an actual member of the default group must be returned as a "
113            + "destination");
114        assertFalse(result.contains(movedOut),
115          "Server moved out of default must not be returned as a destination just because the "
116            + "group being filtered is named 'default'");
117      }
118    } finally {
119      admin.moveServersToRSGroup(new HashSet<>(List.of(addressOf(movedOut))),
120        RSGroupInfo.DEFAULT_GROUP);
121      admin.removeRSGroup(groupName);
122    }
123  }
124
125  /**
126   * A non-default group with one member must return only that member. Same real-cluster approach as
127   * above: the group and its membership come from actual {@code moveServersToRSGroup} calls, not a
128   * hand-built {@link RSGroupInfo}.
129   */
130  @Test
131  public void testNonDefaultGroupFiltersToMembers() throws Exception {
132    Admin admin = TEST_UTIL.getAdmin();
133    List<ServerName> allServers = new ArrayList<>(admin.getRegionServers());
134    assertEquals(2, allServers.size(), "Mini cluster should have started with 2 region servers");
135
136    ServerName member = allServers.get(0);
137    ServerName other = allServers.get(1);
138    String groupName = "test_nondefault_filter";
139
140    admin.addRSGroup(groupName);
141    admin.moveServersToRSGroup(new HashSet<>(List.of(addressOf(member))), groupName);
142    try {
143      RSGroupInfo group = admin.getRSGroup(groupName);
144      assertEquals(1, group.getServers().size(),
145        "Master-computed group should have exactly the one server moved into it");
146      assertTrue(group.containsServer(addressOf(member)),
147        "Server moved into the group must be part of its real membership");
148
149      try (RegionMover rm = buildMover()) {
150        Collection<ServerName> result = rm.filterRSGroupServers(group, allServers);
151        assertEquals(1, result.size(),
152          "filterRSGroupServers should return only the non-default group's actual members");
153        assertTrue(result.contains(member),
154          "Server that is an actual member of the group must be returned as a destination");
155        assertFalse(result.contains(other),
156          "Server that is not a member of the group must not be returned as a destination");
157      }
158    } finally {
159      admin.moveServersToRSGroup(new HashSet<>(List.of(addressOf(member))),
160        RSGroupInfo.DEFAULT_GROUP);
161      admin.removeRSGroup(groupName);
162    }
163  }
164
165  /**
166   * A group's real member must not be returned as a destination when it is absent from the
167   * {@code onlineServers} snapshot handed to the filter (e.g. the server is currently offline or
168   * was already excluded upstream). Uses a real group/member from {@code moveServersToRSGroup}, not
169   * a fabricated, never-existed host address.
170   */
171  @Test
172  public void testGroupMemberAbsentFromOnlineServersReturnsEmpty() throws Exception {
173    Admin admin = TEST_UTIL.getAdmin();
174    List<ServerName> allServers = new ArrayList<>(admin.getRegionServers());
175    assertEquals(2, allServers.size(), "Mini cluster should have started with 2 region servers");
176
177    ServerName member = allServers.get(0);
178    ServerName other = allServers.get(1);
179    String groupName = "test_absent_filter";
180
181    admin.addRSGroup(groupName);
182    admin.moveServersToRSGroup(new HashSet<>(List.of(addressOf(member))), groupName);
183    try {
184      RSGroupInfo group = admin.getRSGroup(groupName);
185      assertEquals(1, group.getServers().size(),
186        "Master-computed group should have exactly the one server moved into it");
187      assertTrue(group.containsServer(addressOf(member)),
188        "Server moved into the group must be part of its real membership");
189
190      try (RegionMover rm = buildMover()) {
191        // The group's only member is not part of the online-servers snapshot passed in.
192        Collection<ServerName> result =
193          rm.filterRSGroupServers(group, Collections.singletonList(other));
194        assertTrue(result.isEmpty(),
195          "Group member absent from the online-servers snapshot must not be returned as a "
196            + "destination");
197      }
198    } finally {
199      admin.moveServersToRSGroup(new HashSet<>(List.of(addressOf(member))),
200        RSGroupInfo.DEFAULT_GROUP);
201      admin.removeRSGroup(groupName);
202    }
203  }
204}
